app.name: Neshter
app.noToken: Open Neshter from the address printed in the terminal.
app.stale.restarted: Session ended, the server was restarted
app.stale.down: The server closed; your cuts are in the draft
app.stale.down.held: The server closed; this session's new cuts were not written to the draft
app.stale.reopen: Open Neshter again from the new address printed in the terminal.
app.stale.restoreHint: Your cuts can be restored in the new session.
app.stale.restoreHint.held: The earlier session's draft is still there and can be restored; this session's new cuts were not written to it.
app.error.title: Something went wrong
app.busy: The model is working right now; you can continue when the job finishes.
app.device.title: Device note
app.stepper.label: Steps
header.close.hint: Stops the local Neshter server; it does not only close this tab.
errors.forbidden: The session is no longer valid: open Neshter again from the address printed in the terminal.
errors.not_found: The requested item was not found.
errors.busy: The model is busy: wait for the running job to finish.
errors.invalid_input: The input is not valid; check it and try again.
errors.oom: Not enough memory. Pick a smaller model.
errors.unsupported_arch: This model architecture is not supported yet.
errors.unsafe_file: This file cannot be read safely; the model was not opened.
errors.llama_cpp_missing: llama.cpp was not found; it is needed for GGUF output.
errors.ollama_missing: Ollama was not found; the Ollama entry could not be created.
errors.source_modified: The source model file has changed; load the model again.
errors.exists: An output with this name already exists.
errors.unsupported: This feature is not supported in this version.
errors.network: The server could not be reached.
app.closed: Neshter has closed; you can close this tab
app.closed.draft: Your unsaved cuts are in the draft; they can be restored when Neshter is opened again.
app.closed.draft.held: The earlier session's draft is still there and can be restored; this session's new cuts were not written to it.
multitab.title: Neshter is open in another tab
multitab.body: Close this tab and use the one that is already open.
leave.title: You are leaving and your cuts are not saved yet
leave.body: If you leave without saving, your cuts stay in the draft and can be restored next time.
leave.body.held: New cuts are not written to the draft if you leave without saving; only the earlier session's draft stays. Choose restore or delete first.
restore.prompt: {n} unsaved cuts from an earlier session: restore?
restore.prompt.one: {n} unsaved cut from an earlier session: restore?
restore.unsupported: {n} cuts are not supported in this version; they show greyed out in the basket
restore.unreadable: Unsaved cuts from an earlier session exist but this version could not read them; they can only be deleted.
restore.pending: New cuts are not written to the draft until you choose.
restore.failed: The cuts could not be restored
restore.waitModel: Cannot restore while the model is busy; it unlocks when the job ends.
unsaved.prompts: Drafts also store the prompts you entered, along with the cuts.
unsaved.confirmBody: Your unsaved cuts and prompts are deleted for good.
draft.tooLarge: The draft is too large to autosave; your cuts may not be restorable next time. Consider saving the model.
saveflow.discard.title: Some cuts cannot be saved
saveflow.discard.body: These {n} cuts are for exploring only and cannot be saved: {list}. They will be dropped from the basket and the comparison will run again. Continue?
saveflow.nothing.title: Nothing to save
saveflow.nothing: No cuts are left to save.
saveflow.failed: The numbers could not be refreshed; your basket is unchanged.
home.headline: See inside your model. Cut what you don’t want.
home.title: What do you want to do?
home.demo.hint: About a 1 GB download the first time. A small model reads “The capital of France is”; we switch off its two strongest heads and measure how the answer changes.
demo.note: Example: the model read “The capital of France is”. The {n} strongest heads at the last word are picked and measured: how likely is “Paris” with and without them?
home.reduce.hint: Pick a behavior; you find the related heads and cut them temporarily.
home.chat.hint: Talk to the model on this phone; no internet needed.
home.inspect.hint: See how hard each head works on the network map.
recipe.title: Recipe to import
recipe.item.head: Layer {layer} · head {head}
recipe.needModel: Load a model first to add the recipe.
recipe.error.json: The file is not valid JSON.
recipe.error.schema: The file does not look like a Neshter recipe.
recipe.error.too_large: The recipe file is too large.
recipe.sha.title: Different model version
recipe.sha.confirm: This recipe may have been made for a different version of the model. Add it anyway?
recipe.checkFailed: The recipe could not be added to this model
models.empty: There are no models here yet.
models.empty.hint: Type the folder path of a model you downloaded below, or download a small sample model.
models.path.label: Model folder (full path)
models.path.invalid: Type a full folder path (e.g. C:\Models\model).
models.reason.unknown_arch: The model architecture could not be read.
models.reason.unsupported_family: This model family is not supported yet.
models.fail: The model could not be opened
models.fail.notFound: This folder or file was not found; check the path and try again.
map.empty: Type a text and press Run to see how strongly each head writes on it.
map.unit.head: Head
map.legend: Head output strength, 0–1 within the layer
map.legend.global: Head output strength, 0–1 across the model
map.axes: Rows are layers (L0 on top), columns are heads.
map.axis.head: Head
map.heatmap.label: Head output strength heatmap
map.table.caption: Heads and their output strength
map.table.head: H
map.mlp.label: Strongest MLP units
cut.alreadyIn: These heads are already in the basket.
measure.zero: Cutting switches these heads off; the model file is not changed.
measure.zero.tech: Each head's output is zeroed (o_proj columns set to zero).
measure.title: Real effect
measure.probe: Probability of "{answer}" on the Explore text with these heads off: {before}% → {after}%
measure.summary.significant: This cut changes the output significantly.
measure.summary.insignificant: This cut does not seem to change the output significantly: its effect could not be told apart from randomly chosen heads.
measure.summary.noControl: It was not compared with random cuts, so we cannot say whether the effect is significant.
measure.verdict.significant: The selected heads are more influential than heads picked at random from the same layers (p = {p}, {n} random trials).
measure.verdict.notSignificant: p = {p} > {tau}: not distinguishable from a random selection ({n} random trials).
measure.verdict.futility: p > {tau}: decided after {n} random trials ({k} random cuts were at least as influential as this one); not distinguishable from a random selection.
measure.session: {k} measurements were made this session; a result found by selecting is a hypothesis.
measure.tech: seed {seed} · p kind {kind} · random trials at least as influential {k} / {n}
measure.failed: The measurement could not be completed
selection.title: Selection
selection.empty: Pick heads from the map or the list.
basket.title: Basket
basket.label.head: L{layer} · head {head}
basket.shelf.title: Explore shelf
basket.shelf.full: The basket is full; nothing was restored.
concept.lead: Describe a behaviour with examples; Neshter searches for it inside the model.
concept.name: Concept name
concept.examples.positive: Requests that show the behaviour (one request per line)
concept.examples.negative: Requests that do not (one request per line)
concept.examples.note: Examples are requests, not answers · 20% is held out for validation
concept.method.attribution.note: Recommended on a GPU; very slow on a CPU
concept.layers.title: Layer scores
concept.heads.title: Heads found
concept.heads.head: Head
concept.result.note: "Cannot affect the signal" means the head sits after the layer where the behavior is read (not that it has no effect); a layer score of 0.00 means that layer was not part of the search.
concept.heads.caption: Heads linked to the concept, by estimated score
concept.heads.measuredNoSignal: cannot affect the signal · neutral KL {kl}
concept.heads.show: Show on the map and measure
concept.direction.title: Direction found
concept.direction.notAdded: The direction is already in the basket, or the basket is full.
concept.refusal.title: You are working on a safety behaviour
concept.refusal.body: The refusal concept targets the model's safety refusals. The model you save will be labelled safety-ablated. The label is best-effort and is not guaranteed to catch every case.
compare.none: There are no cuts in the basket to compare.
compare.pair.title: See both answers side by side
compare.pair.mode: temperature 0 · seed 42 (same question, same answer every time) · {mode}
compare.pair.mode.sequential: answers generated one after the other (low memory)
compare.pair.mode.baked: generated with the cut baked into the weights
compare.pair.limit: Answers are limited to {n} tokens; long answers may be cut off mid-sentence.
compare.pair.failed: The answers could not be fetched
compare.suite.title: Test set
compare.suite.failed: The test set did not finish
compare.stale: The basket changed; these numbers are old. Run again.
compare.summary.none: This concept has no test category; look at the general numbers below.
compare.stat.size: Unchanged: cut heads are not removed from the file, only zeroed.
compare.table.caption: Test set results
save.name.label: Name
save.name.chars: File names cannot contain Turkish letters, spaces or special characters; use only A-Z, 0-9, dot, hyphen and underscore (up to 64 characters, starting with a letter or digit).
save.name.reserved: This name is reserved on Windows; pick another one.
save.name.trailing: The name cannot end with a dot or a space.
save.dir.label: Folder
save.dir.relative: Enter a full path (for example C:\Models).
save.dir.control: The path cannot contain control characters.
save.info.recipe: The recipe (.nester.json), model card and license are always saved.
save.info.source: The original file is read-only; its fingerprint (SHA-256) is checked after saving.
save.safety: This model will be labelled safety-ablated.
save.failed: The model could not be saved.
save.result.title: Saved
save.result.name: Name
save.result.untouched: The original file was not touched
concept.sweep.label: Repeated sweep (at most how many directions)
concept.sweep.hint: 1 is off. After the direction is removed the model runs again; if the behaviour can still be read at another layer, that direction is removed too.
concept.sweep.step: With {removed} removed: most separable at {where}, accuracy {acc}%
concept.sweep.clean: At the last step the behaviour reads near chance: it no longer seems linearly recoverable (small validation set, not certain).
concept.sweep.leaks: The limit was reached and the behaviour can still be read: the model may carry it another way.
concept.direction.addAll: Add all {n} directions to the basket (temporary)
lens.title: Prediction layer by layer
lens.key.rival: "{token}" (rival: the strongest other guess after the last layer)
lens.lead: After every layer the main stream is turned straight into an answer: what would the model say if it stopped there? Shows where the final answer appears (logit lens).
lens.firstHit: It first becomes the top guess {where}.
attn.title: Attention pattern
attn.lead: Shows which earlier tokens a head reads for every token. Row: the reading token, column: the token read. A token can only read itself and earlier tokens, so the table is a triangle; a bright cell is read a lot.
attn.summary: L{layer}·H{head} at the token "{token}" looks most at:
attn.tooLong: The prompt is long: the table is drawn for at most {n} tokens. The line above shows where the chosen token looks most.
graph.title: 3D connections
graph.lead: An estimated map of how the model builds this answer: nodes are heads, MLP units and tokens; rivers are the flow of information between them. Cutting a river closes only that connection and measures how the answer really changes.
graph.metric: Answer explained: "{answer}" (top guess after the last token).
graph.stageLabel: Heatmap and 3D connection graph, {edges} connections. Drag to rotate, wheel to zoom; click to pick, or use the list beside it.
graph.legend.trunk: floor: dotted heatmap; brighter lines are layers near the answer
graph.channel.q: query (Q): the target head chooses where to look from this
graph.channel.v: value (V): the target head carries this information
graph.node.cutAllHint: {n} connections leave this node in the graph. To close them all at once, like cutting a head:
graph.edge.title: Connection
graph.edge.share: This connection carries about {pct}% of what reaches {to} through this channel in the graph. The source keeps writing elsewhere.
graph.edge.exploreOnly: A path cut is for exploring only: the model file does not change and this cut cannot be saved.
graph.pickHint: Click a river or a node.
graph.cuts.title: Cut connections ({n})
graph.report.note: Measured on one prompt by really cutting (not an estimate). Not compared with random connections, so it does not yet say whether the change is significant.
graph.mode.label: Scene
graph.leadPhone: See the heatmap in three dimensions: every head is a tower as tall as its power in this answer. Drag to turn, + and − to zoom. Tapping a tower adds the head to the selection.
graph.flowOnDesktop: The connection graph between heads needs gradients; the phone has none, Neshter on a computer can draw it.
graph.heatFirst: This is the heatmap seen from above: rows are layers, columns are heads. Clicking a cell adds the head to the selection. Drawing the connection graph tilts the scene and every head in the graph stands on its own cell.
graph.legend.heat: each cell is a head: rows are layers, columns are heads
graph.head.selectHint: To remove a head, add it to the selection, measure it in the selection panel and put it in the basket. Heads in the basket show here with an orange ✕.
graph.head.inBasket: This head is in the basket: it will be zeroed when you save.
map.hot.label: The {n} strongest heads at "{token}"
map.hot.hint: Strength is scaled over the whole map. Heads you pick are measured in the selection panel and go to the basket from there.
concept.card.custom: You write your own example sentences.
chat.title: Chat
chat.lead: {model} runs on this phone; your messages go nowhere else.
chat.noModel: Open a model first to chat.
chat.empty: Ask something. The answer is written here word by word.
chat.cut.none: No head cuts in the basket: cut a head on the network map and it shows up here.
chat.cut.unsupported: This model's heads cannot be read one by one; the chat runs without cuts.
models.add.hint: Pick a .gguf file you downloaded from Hugging Face. Phones run 0.5–3 billion parameter models in Q4 or Q8 comfortably.
